input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: § 12.3 expressly preserves our freedom to develop, acquire, license, sell or use any product or service and to operate in any field or territory, and records that we have given no non-compete or field-of-use commitment. This meets the preferred position (no non-compete restriction on Customer). No other clause binds us competitively: § 2.1 confirms no purchase commitment, § 13.4 is a standard acceptable-use restriction rather than a competitive covenant, and § 24.2 restricts Vendor, not us. § 2.2 (sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services) is a supply-exclusivity term that sits under the separate exclusivity rule and is addressed there rather than double-flagged here.
